invariants: The bridge verifies payload kind == the registered expected kind BEFORE the handler runs; the handler's fallback arm is therefore unreachable in correct operation and returns WorkError::rejected(500, "payload_mismatch") - it never panics.
Handlers are thin: match the one variant, call exactly one port method through the context, map the result into WorkResponse. No validation logic, no SQL.
responsibilities: Register the five read routes (get, list, events, result, cicd_stage_log) on the bridge builder.
signature: pub fn register_reads<'a>(builder: &mut forge_core::bridge::RegistryBuilder<'a, crate::work_payload::WorkPayload, crate::work_response::WorkContext<'a>, crate::work_response::WorkResponse, crate::work_error::WorkError>) -> Result<(), crate::work_error::WorkError>;
